contentPattern.structure: solid full-color tile + title + corner arrow link (no icon, no description)

suitableFor: colored product/category tile grids inside a dark band
linked tiles with only a title and an arrow (no icon, no body copy)
notSuitableFor: white bordered cards with icon + one-line description (use cards-capabilities)
article/news cards with photographic thumbnails and dates (use cards-insights)
